acceptance_predicates.description: Every canonical supported backend has exactly one model-capability record; CI rejects missing, duplicate, or untested backends.
Every model-bearing backend exposes a bounded normalized generation/digest-bound model catalog with typed availability; model-less backends explicitly declare not_applicable.
Human and JSON setup/easy surfaces select only catalog-backed backend/model pairs and reject stale, unavailable, unknown, or cross-backend identities before effects.
A complete normal benchmark run preserves exact backend, profile, model, catalog generation, digest, and execution mode through results and reports.
Every bounded sweep point preserves the selected backend/model identity, concurrency limits, cleanup, and typed partial failures without fallback.
Deterministic fixtures qualify every supported backend cell without credentials; optional live checks add evidence but never block development completion.
Catalogs, selections, logs, state, and receipts contain no credential values or raw provider payloads, and execution never silently changes backend or mode.

definition_of_done: The canonical backend registry and model-capability matrix are mechanically exhaustive at the exact implementation head.
Catalog, selection, plan, full run, bounded sweep, result/report, comparison, fault, cleanup, and privacy fixtures pass for every supported backend.
Independent exact-head review, required hosted checks, signed/DCO merge, exact-main post-merge checks, and a privacy-safe receipt pass.

inputs.description: Exact-head canonical ASB backend registry after AR-1733, including OpenRouter and cli2key plus retained local/mock or replay modes.

outputs.description: Exhaustive registry-bound catalog and selection semantics for every supported backend.
Privacy-safe exact-head evidence for full run and bounded sweep execution across every supported backend cell.

gates.description: Registry-to-model-capability completeness and hostile selection tests pass.
Every supported backend completes deterministic full-run and bounded-sweep fixtures with exact identity propagation.
No secret, raw provider response, or silent backend/mode fallback enters output, state, or evidence.
